subject: SIG / SOC2 request: encryption, key custody & supply-chain evidence checklist
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@blueharbor.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@blueharbor.com
Date: 2027-06-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG / SOC2: encryption & KMS evidence needed for onboarding

Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of BlueHarbor's SIG intake and our SOC2 evidence collection, we need a set of encryption/key-management artifacts to satisfy both the SIG Exemplar and our internal compliance team. Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce the following items by 2027-06-21? If you need to stagger delivery that's fine, but please indicate the expected delivery date for each item.

- HSM attestation (vendor name/model/serial, FIPS/HSM compliance statement, attestation PDF signed by vendor)
- Key ceremony witness logs (redacted IDs OK) for the last two custody events
- Sample key rotation logs for the last 12 months (CSV export with timestamps, rotated_key_id, actor)
- KMS IAM/role matrix for tenant and platform roles (who can wrap/unwrap, who can rotate, who has emergency unseal)
- Transport/wrapping process description (how KEKs are wrapped during transit and how we verify integrity)
- Supply-chain manifest for HSM firmware/patch history (SHA sums, vendor patch IDs)
- BYOK wrap/unwrap test vectors (sample ciphertext + step-by-step derivation to verify wrap behavior)
- Diagram of data-at-rest encryption architecture (tenant boundary, envelope encryption flow)
- Any signed non-repudiation artifacts for rotation ceremonies (witness signatures, timestamps)

If any of these require an export control review or cannot be shared verbatim, please flag it and propose an alternative (e.g., redacted logs, auditor-only access). Also: preferred delivery mechanism is a secure ShareFile link or an SFTP drop; please include checksums for large bundles.

Thanks — would appreciate a single thread with a checklist/ETA we can track.

Alice Nguyen
Staff Security Engineer, BlueHarbor
alice.nguyen@blueharbor.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@blueharbor.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-06-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / SOC2: encryption & KMS evidence needed for onboarding

Alice —

Appreciate the detailed list. We can provide the majority of these artifacts; a few items will need controlled delivery or redaction (HSM vendor-signed attestation is fine, but raw key material and some internal audit keys must be redacted). Proposed plan:

- Commitment: deliver primary bundle by 2027-06-18; sensitive items (attestation originals, ceremony witness raw logs) on 2027-06-21 via secure ShareFile with auditor access.
- Deliverables split: 
  * Public-ready: KMS role matrix (CSV), rotation_log_sample.csv (redacted actor ids), architecture diagram, supplychain_manifest.md (firmware IDs + checksums).
  * Auditor-only: full HSM attestation PDF (vendor-signed), unredacted ceremony logs, BYOK test vectors where they reveal secret material.

Jonas and Laura — tagging you for action. Jonas, can you confirm we can produce the HSM attestation PDF and the firmware manifest? Laura, can your team export the rotation logs and generate the redacted CSV?

I'll assemble an evidence_index.json and a checklist so BlueHarbor can tick items as they arrive. Do you have a preferred checksum algorithm (SHA256 ok)? Also confirm ShareFile vs SFTP — we'll default to ShareFile and provide an SFTP fallback.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0119

From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-06-11T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL - actions for BlueHarbor evidence pack

Marissa / Laura —

Internal plan & owners (ETA in parentheses):

1) HSM attestation & firmware manifest: I'll reach out to HSM vendor contacts today, request vendor-signed attestation PDF and full firmware history export (ETA: 2027-06-17).
2) Rotation logs export: Laura, please produce a redacted CSV of the last 12 months including columns {timestamp, rotated_key_id, rotation_type, changed_by_role}. Redact human IDs; include role tags (ETA: 2027-06-15).
3) Ceremony witness artifacts: we'll provide signed timestamps and a redacted witness summary for public delivery and grant auditor access to the raw logs via secure drive (ETA: raw 2027-06-21 / redacted 2027-06-18).
4) BYOK test vectors: crypto team to provide deterministic wrap/unwrap sample vectors that do not expose key material; outline steps rather than raw secrets (ETA: 2027-06-16).
5) Architecture diagram + role matrix: I will update the diagram to call out envelope encryption boundaries and add the KMS role matrix CSV (ETA: 2027-06-15).

We will stage artifacts in a secure folder: https://drive.google.com/folderview?id=fake-folder-enc-evidence (access by invitation only). I will also assemble evidence_index.json that maps each requested item to the file name, delivery method (public vs auditor-only), checksum, and redaction notes.

If anything cannot be delivered, we will give an alternative (auditor access, redacted summary, or signed attestation).

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.example.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@blueharbor.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-06-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / SOC2: encryption & KMS evidence needed for onboarding

Alice —

Quick update and delivery plan (single-thread checklist below). We are targeting two deliveries: a public bundle and an auditor-only bundle. All checksums will be SHA256 unless you request otherwise. Final artifacts will be uploaded to a ShareFile folder and we will provide an SFTP URL if that is preferable.

Planned deliverables & ETAs:
- redwood_kms_role_matrix.csv (public) — 2027-06-15
- rotation_log_sample.csv (public, redacted) — 2027-06-15
- supplychain_manifest.md (public, firmware IDs + checksums) — 2027-06-17
- architecture_diagram.pdf (public) — 2027-06-15
- BYOK_test_vectors.txt (auditor-only, redaction applied) — 2027-06-16
- hsm_attestation_2026.pdf (auditor-only, vendor-signed) — 2027-06-21
- ceremony_witness_summary.txt (public, redacted) + raw logs (auditor-only) — 2027-06-18 / 2027-06-21

Attachments included in the public bundle (stubs): redwood_kms_role_matrix.csv, rotation_log_sample.csv, architecture_diagram.pdf, supplychain_manifest.md, evidence_index.json. Auditor-only artifacts will be shared via tokenized ShareFile links; we will include an access list for your audit team.

If that schedule works for BlueHarbor, we'll proceed. If you need anything earlier, let us know which items are highest priority and we'll accelerate accordingly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0119
